verdict.rationale: An email product could plausibly ship an AI assistant that connects to MCP servers, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of MCP or of any way to connect external tool servers to Fastmail. The JMAP API, API tokens and push are developer building blocks for others to call Fastmail, not an MCP-client capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
